BrokenLore: DON’T PLAY is a first-person psychological horror experience, part of the BrokenLore saga.

You follow Hideo, a reclusive hikikomori obsessed with video games. When a mysterious experimental console arrives at his door, he decides to play, believing it could change his life.

It does.

With every session, the line between game and reality begins to break. His apartment shifts, time distorts, and something dark starts to emerge, creeping into the real world.
